|gr1= GUI Control - Controls Table

|descr= Adds one row of controls according to the RowTemplate class. It returns an array containing row index and array of created controls in a format [<rowIndex>, [<control0>, <control1>...<control n>]].
<br>
Note that rows and headers are indexed separately.

|s1= [[ctAddRow]] control

|p1= control: [[Control]]

|r1= [[Array]]

|x1= <sqf>_array = ctAddRow _control;</sqf>
